# Nikko Dialysis Center

> Outpatient haemodialysis centre in [AREA], Nairobi, Kenya. Tagline: "Life. Hope. Better Tomorrow." Accepts SHA (Social Health Authority) and major Kenyan medical insurers. Offers holiday dialysis for people visiting Nairobi.

## Key facts
- Services: haemodialysis (usually 3 sessions a week, about 4 hours each), holiday/visiting dialysis, vascular access care, kidney diet education, nephrologist reviews and transplant referral.
- Shifts: morning [06:00–10:00], midday [11:00–15:00], evening [16:00–20:00]. Open Mon–Fri [06:00–20:00], Sat [06:00–16:00], Sun [Closed].
- Insurance: SHA, Jubilee Insurance, AAR Insurance, Britam, CIC Insurance, APA Insurance, Madison Insurance, Old Mutual, ICEA LION, Sanlam Allianz, GA Insurance, First Assurance and many others.
- Payment: M-Pesa (Paybill [PAYBILL]), Airtel Money (Till [TILL]), bank transfer, cash.
- Address: [STREET ADDRESS], [AREA], Nairobi, Kenya. Phone: [+254 PHONE]. WhatsApp: [+254 WHATSAPP]. Email: info@example.com.
- Booking: new patients, transfers and visitors request a consultation at https://nikkodialysis.vercel.app/contact. A nurse calls back within one working day.
- Emergencies: this centre is not an emergency department. In an emergency go to the nearest hospital emergency department or call 999 / 112.
